subject: Use clusterNodeIsVotingPrimary function to check the right (#735)
reason: This is a semantics-preserving refactor: the inline checks `nodeIsReplica(node) || node->numslots == 0` in clearNodeFailureIfNeeded and clusterSendFailoverAuthIfNeeded are replaced by `!clusterNodeIsVotingPrimary(node)`, whose definition ((flags & CLUSTER_NODE_PRIMARY) && numslots) is logically equivalent for every reachable node state — the two conditions could only diverge for a node with assigned slots but neither role flag set, which cannot occur since handshake nodes (the only nodes without a role flag) always have numslots == 0 and slots are only attributed to nodes already flagged prima
